text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Up until this point, I was mid-pack.
And then, in the final straight, all at once—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Did you need something from me?
Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...!
I just got curious...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What you're watching on the PC is the mock race from the other day, right?
Um... the one you ran with Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... are heavy...!
At this rate, I won't reach her...!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She took first place, while I lost steam in the final half and finished 6th.
A complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't lose next time.
...I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...You're so strong.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I ran in a different race that day.
And like you, Ayabe-san, I finished 6th... And because of that, I still haven't recovered from it...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yet you, Ayabe-san... you never stop, you keep striving and pushing forward—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...What can I do
to become strong like that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm not strong.
...I just have resolve.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There is a goal I must fulfill.
Even if I lose a race, even if I'm not in top form, I cannot afford to halt my steps.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: People who once only looked up and yearned for the stars... through continuous effort, they can now journey into space—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep moving forward, you will reach the stars someday.
As long as you don't lose your convictions, just like them, surely.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have one too?
Something you cannot compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot lose...!
My other half... my precious sister—
For your sake...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Daaaahhhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Admire Vega crosses the finish line!
A commanding victory by a massive margin over the rest of the field!
She has magnificently avenged her previous defeat!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, congratulations...!
choice_data_list: That was a run packed with sheer ferocity!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Strong and dazzling, like a first-magnitude star twinkling in the night sky—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely win next time too...!
Shining just like Ayabe-san... and one day, becoming a true "hero"...!
